name: deck-html
description: Build autonomous HTML slides (16:9) from a presentation JSON spec produced by deck-outline: pick a theme + palette, then build_html.py copies templates/slides.html, injects the palette into :root CSS variables and replaces the layout blocks. Mandatory verification gate: verify_slides.py in real Chromium (Playwright) — overflow/text-clipping/layout/navigation checks, exit 0/1 — plus a visual pass and the product-designer review checklist. Triggers: 'сделай слайды', 'слайды html', 'презентация html', 'html slides', '16:9 слайды', 'собрать слайды', 'build slides', 'сверстать презентацию'.
author: bestdeejay-design
